fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Personal API key generated under Account settings > Store settings on stickermule.com (shown once; personal accounts only, not team accounts), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It can place orders on the saved payment methods.

config_fields.name: payment_id
config_fields.help: paymentId for create_order: a saved payment method id from GET /api/payments (not mapped). Orders are charged to it.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: ISO 4217 currency for list_products prices (the `currency` query parameter; Sticker Mule defaults to USD).

config_fields.name: locale
config_fields.help: Locale for product names and prices in list_products (the `locale` query parameter; default en).

me.note: Sticker Mule has no account endpoint; the probe reads one saved item (GET /api/items?limit=1) with the key, so `account` is {items, canLoadMore}. A bad key answers 403 ForbiddenError, a missing one 401.

list_products.note: GET /api/items: only the items you have ordered before and can reorder ('Custom items, packaging tape, and vinyl lettering are not available through the API'). `id` is the item id to pass in create_order items; `price` is retailPrice at the minimum quantity in the currency setting. Rows whose productName is null (product no longer available) are dropped. `query` and `category` are not accepted; limit 1-50, offset paging.

create_order.note: POST /api/orders places a real reorder and CHARGES the saved payment method from the payment_id setting (GET /api/payments). `items` are [{id (item id from list_products), quantity (within the item's min/max/increment), size (sizeS…size7XL, apparel only)}], up to 50; `shipping_address` must carry `id`, a saved address id from GET /api/addresses (addresses cannot be created through the API). `shipping_option` is not sent. Answers {order: {number}}.

not_offered.get_product: No single-item endpoint; the documented endpoints are GET /api/items, /api/addresses, /api/payments, /api/orders and POST /api/orders only.
not_offered.get_order: GET /api/orders only lists placed orders ('most recent first', limit/offset) with no order-number filter; there is no single-order endpoint.
not_offered.track: No tracking endpoint; GET /api/orders carries only shipmentState, expectedDeliveryDate and deliveredAt per order, no tracking numbers or events.
